page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 cores running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. It lacks local storage and dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear tradeoff between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 25% tier, reflecting the older Broadwell architecture of the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor. However, multi-core performance is more robust, achieving average tier results in stress-ng multi-core, Passmark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core tests. Memory bandwidth also remains in the average tier, with read-only large block bandwidth measured at 98.48 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge offers dedicated compute resources at a lower price-to-performance tier compared to newer generation hardware. It is well-suited for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage the 32 vCPUs, such as static web serving, database operations, and software compilation, while being less optimal for single-threaded tasks or applications requiring advanced vector extensions like AVX-512 VNNI.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of RAM, powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. Built on the KVM hypervisor, this x86_64 server provides a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio but lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Performance benchmarks reveal a distinct tradeoff: single-core performance is relatively weak, whereas multi-core execution, memory bandwidth, and database operations consistently reach average tiers. With a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps, this instance offers a cost-efficient profile for multi-threaded workloads that do not demand the latest CPU microarchitectures. It is best suited for tasks such as static web serving, software compilation, and medium-scale database operations.
